checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Loads the specified slots (1,2,3,9,11 tips/plates, mag module 4, reservoir 5, tempdeck 6 with thermo plate, racks 7/10), p1000 left, p300 multi right, and calls temp_mod.set_temperature(4).
Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns, fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact and distinct_elution_wells pass; the loop uses p1000 with a new tip per tube and dispenses into its own well.

Beads 40 uL, then isopropanol 250 uL, then sample 250 uL with p1000.mix(5,...), then 5 min delay before mag_mod.engage(); checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample and incubation_5min_before_magnet pass.

mag_mod.engage() followed by a 4 min delay, then 540 uL removed in 3x180 uL at slow aspirate rate 30 from bottom(1) to the waste plate; magnet_4min_before_first_removal and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals pass.
The two 500 uL ethanol washes are each added then removed with the magnet engaged (split into 3 trips); two_500ul_ethanol_washes and supernatant_removed_each_step pass.
ctx.delay(minutes=4) after the last wash removal, then mag_mod.disengage() before elution; air_dry_4min passes.

Elution of 100 uL is added off-magnet and mixed, and the magnet is re-engaged for 90 s, but the code recovers 100 uL (aspirate(ELUTION_VOL)) rather than ~80 uL, risking bead carryover and air aspiration.

Volumes are split to 180 uL or less per trip, about 34 of 36 available 200 uL tip columns are used, and the code uses slow aspirate rates and sensible heights; no pause is needed because all tips fit on the deck.

The step order matches the paper, but the recovery volume is 100 uL instead of 80 uL, and the docstring and metadata misattribute the paper to 'Rodriguez-Sanchez et al.' instead of Lázaro-Perona et al.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 measured checks and follows the paper's sequence of binding, magnetic separation, two washes, drying and elution closely. Its flaws are recovering 100 uL instead of ~80 uL of eluate and a misattributed author name in the docstring and metadata.
